ORDER OF BUSINESS - Mr. Armey asked unanimous consent that when the House convenes at 8 a.m. today that there be no intervening motion from the time of convening until the Pledge of Allegiance, and that further consideration of the bill H.R. 1555 in the Committee of the Whole pursuant to H. Res. 207 shall also be governed by the following order: 1. Immediately after the Pledge, the House shall resolve into the Committee of the Whole for the further consideration of the bill pursuant to H. Res. 207; 2. consideration in the Committee of the Whole shall proceed without intervening motion except the amendments printed in House Rept. 104-223, except one motion to rise, if offered by Rep. Bliley; 3. that any amendment adopted in the Committee of the Whole shall be deemed as having been adopted in the House; and 4. that Rep. Conyers shall have permission to modify amendment No. 2-2. Agreed to without objection.
Committee of the Whole House on the state of the Union rises leaving H.R. 1555 as unfinished business.

Mr. Bliley moved that the Committee rise.

The Speaker designated the Honorable Jim Kolbe to act as Chairman of the Committee.
House resolved itself into the Committee of the Whole House on the state of the Union pursuant to H. Res. 207 and Rule XXIII.

Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 1555 with 1 hour and 30 minutes of general debate. Previous question shall be considered as ordered without intervening motions except motion to recommit. During the consideration of the bill in the Committee of the Whole, the Chairman of the Committee may postpone until a time during further consideration requests for a recorded vote on any amendment. Measure will be read by section. Specified amendments are in order. It shall be in order to consider as an original bill for the purpose of amendment the amendment in the nature of a substitute recommended by the Committee on Commerce now printed in the bill. Before consideration of any other amendment, it shall be in order to consider the amendment printed in part 1 of the report accompanying this resolution.
